stories.title: China mandates sustainability reporting for major firms
stories.summary: China has introduced mandatory sustainability reporting guidelines for constituents of major indices and dual-listed companies. Effective since May 2024, the rules require these firms to prepare and publicly disclose reports covering the 2025 calendar year by April 2027. Compliance is now a standard operational requirement.

stories.title: Dutch government submits revised CSRD implementation decree
stories.summary: The Dutch government has submitted a third version of its draft Implementation Decree for the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive to Parliament. The update confirms the abandonment of retroactive application for the legislation. The decree is intended to align national law with the EU directive and omnibus amendments.

stories.title: Onesource Specialty Pharma receives unsolicited ESG rating
stories.summary: Onesource Specialty Pharma has been assigned a 'Crisil ESG 65' rating by Crisil ESG Ratings & Analytics. The company did not engage the agency for the assessment, which was based entirely on publicly available information. The rating places the firm in a strong category for sustainable business practices.

stories.title: Sanlam Allianz Investments publishes first sustainability report
stories.summary: Sanlam Allianz Investments Limited has released its inaugural sustainability report, detailing its ESG integration across Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania. The firm manages over Sh819 billion in assets. The publication arrives in anticipation of regional sustainability reporting requirements set to adopt IFRS S1 and S2 standards.

stories.title: Dabur India receives independent ESG rating
stories.summary: Dabur India has been assigned an ESG rating of 75 by CFC Finlease Private Limited. The rating was determined independently using publicly available information without any direct engagement from the company. The disclosure was made in accordance with SEBI listing obligations regarding material information.

stories.title: Sanlam Allianz Investments prepares for 2027 reporting rules
stories.summary: Sanlam Allianz Investments Limited has published its first sustainability report, titled Performance with Purpose. The document outlines ESG integration across its East African operations ahead of new reporting mandates arriving in 2027. The firm will align its future disclosures with International Financial Reporting Standards.

stories.title: Enpara Bank General Assembly Elects Eight-Member Board, Approves Sustainability Report - TipRanks
Rīgas meži earns international sustainability transparency award
stories.summary: SIA Rīgas meži received the highest excellence level in the Transparency Award ESG Reporting 2026 assessment. The German research group EUPD awarded the company Leading Company status after reviewing reports from over 1,000 organisations. The firm considers this its most significant international achievement in sustainability reporting to date.

stories.title: ECO Mobility earns EcoVadis commitment badge
stories.summary: ECO Mobility has received the EcoVadis Commitment Badge following its first sustainability assessment. The company operates a fleet of over 20,500 vehicles across 160 cities. The assessment evaluated the firm's internal policies across environment, labor, ethics and procurement pillars during its inaugural year of reporting.

stories.title: EU and UK to link carbon markets by 2028
stories.summary: The EU and UK have agreed to link their emissions trading systems by 2028 to create a larger, more liquid carbon market. The UK government estimates the move could add £3.8 billion to its economy annually by 2040 and reduce trade barriers for British exports.

stories.title: Ghana targets $68 million from forest carbon credits
stories.summary: Ghana expects to generate $68 million from the sale of 6.5 million tonnes of verified forest carbon credits. International buyers have already committed $43 million for the first four million tonnes. The credits represent carbon dioxide kept out of the air through forest protection and restoration.

stories.title: Uzbekistan secures $8.5 million grant for carbon market
stories.summary: Uzbekistan will receive an $8.5 million grant from South Korea to develop its international carbon market framework. The project, supported by the Korea International Cooperation Agency and the Global Green Growth Institute, aims to establish procedures and a joint action plan for trading carbon credits.

stories.title: Carbon markets advance despite stalled COP31 negotiations
stories.summary: While UN climate talks at COP31 failed to reach a broad agreement, carbon credit markets continued to expand through bilateral coalitions. The event marked a turning point for climate action, as governments increasingly bypass multilateral stalemates to pursue independent deals and regional climate solutions.

stories.title: New methodology targets carbon credits from scrapped vehicles
stories.summary: A new methodology approved by Cercarbono aims to convert end-of-life vehicles into carbon credits. With India's fleet of scrapped vehicles projected to reach 50 million by 2030, the initiative seeks to transform a growing waste management challenge into a measurable climate and circular economy opportunity.

stories.title: ASEAN pursues interoperable regional carbon markets
stories.summary: ASEAN is moving to link its fragmented carbon markets through regional interoperability rather than uniform national regulations. According to the World Economic Forum, this approach allows member states to respect varying economic stages while channeling climate finance into clean energy and nature-based solutions across the region.

stories.title: Harnessing Carbon Credit Auctioning to top Uganda’s Foreign Exchange Earnings after Coffee and Gold by 2030 - PML Daily
GEF Capital Partners raises $615 million for climate fund
stories.summary: GEF Capital Partners has closed its fourth climate fund at $615 million, a 40 percent increase over its previous vehicle. The fund will target mid-market, growth-stage businesses in India and South Asia focused on energy transition. The announcement was made at the Climate Capital Summit 2026.

stories.title: Megawide eyes April 2027 launch for ₱1-billion Carbon Market Block-2 - Manila Bulletin
COP31 concludes without final agreement
stories.summary: The UN climate summit in Antalya ended without a final agreement after two weeks of talks and two days of overtime. Delegates failed to reach consensus on a cover decision, leaving the summit without a deal on fossil fuels or climate finance. The deadlock remains unbroken.

stories.title: CARICOM Disappointed at Outcome of COP31
stories.summary: GEORGETOWN, Guyana to The 15-member Caribbean Community (CARICOM) grouping Monday expressed “its deep disappointment” that delegates who attended the United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Türkiye, were unable to reach agreement on a cover decision that would have set out the urgent action needed as the world approaches

stories.title: European Parliament debates COP31 collapse
stories.summary: The collapse of COP31 has triggered a rift in the European Parliament. Some lawmakers advocate for stronger climate action, while others suggest the failure justifies scaling back EU targets. One MEP compared the lack of a fossil fuel agreement to an attempt to extinguish a fire.

stories.title: UN climate summit ends in deadlock
stories.summary: COP31 concluded in Antalya without a final agreement after talks stretched two days past the scheduled end. Contentious negotiations over fossil fuels and climate finance collapsed, marking the first time a UN climate summit has ended without a deal since 2009. Diplomacy is currently experiencing strains.

stories.title: L'Oréal reports sustainability progress in Mexico
stories.summary: L'Oréal Groupe confirmed its two Mexican manufacturing plants now operate on 100 percent renewable energy. The company reported producing over 420 million units annually, alongside 84 refillable products and social programs supporting 46,000 jobs. The results were presented during a sustainability forum in November 2026.

stories.title: Circular economy: Aviation takes on the resource challenge - Safran
UNIDO launches circular economy toolkit for SMEs
stories.summary: UNIDO has launched a digital Circular Economy Toolbox for small and medium enterprises in Armenia, Moldova and Ukraine. The resource includes over 70 tools, including self-assessment guides and methodologies designed to help businesses move toward more resource-efficient practices. The programme is funded by the European Union.

stories.title: Circular Urban Economy in Karnataka: Waste to Wealth
stories.summary: Karnataka’s approach to waste management is gradually moving beyond simply collecting and disposing of waste. The focus is increasingly on segregation, recycling, recovery, and finding productive uses for materials that would otherwise end up in landfills. The Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026, which came into effect on April 1, 2026,

stories.summary: What role can businesses play in building a transition towards a circular economy that is also fair and inclusive? stories.summary: Join the Conference on Roadmap to Circular Economy Through Plastics Recycling on 9 December 2026 at The Leela, Mumbai. Explore advanced recycling, GST regulations, funding circularity, new polymers and sustainable packaging.

stories.title: Siemens Energy India reports 30.4 percent revenue growth
stories.summary: Siemens Energy India reported revenue of INR 3,453 crore for the fourth quarter, a 30.4 percent increase year-on-year. Profit after tax rose 81.5 percent to INR 653 crore, while new orders grew 92.1 percent. The company attributed the results to operational excellence and disciplined order execution.

stories.title: Acme Solar commissions 50.01 MW in Rajasthan
stories.summary: Acme Solar Holdings commissioned 50.01 megawatts of solar capacity at its Hybrid Power Project in Bikaner, Rajasthan. The site now has 250.05 megawatts of its planned 300 megawatts in operation. The company stated the milestone underlines its ongoing commitment to enhancing renewable energy capabilities.

stories.title: Carbon credits move to the center of corporate climate strategy
stories.summary: Carbon credits are no longer a peripheral add-on but a structural component of net-zero plans, according to a panel of sustainability leaders. The group noted that 81 percent of buyers consider the credits important or critical to meeting climate goals as pressure from regulators and investors rises.

stories.title: Umicore updates sustainability roadmap after SBTi validation
stories.summary: Umicore has updated its sustainability roadmap following SBTi validation of its net-zero targets across all scopes. The new framework adds measurable 2030 goals for gender representation, pay, and inclusion. The company continues to broaden its climate and workforce objectives alongside its existing operational targets.

stories.title: Goldman Sachs upgrades ITM Power to neutral
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs upgraded ITM Power from sell to neutral, raising its price target from 70p to 73p. The analyst house noted the change was driven by the share price slide rather than a revision of business forecasts. The balance of upside and downside is now seen as even.

stories.title: Renault Group presents decarbonization initiatives at COP31
stories.summary: Renault Group showcased its efforts to reduce greenhouse gas emissions across its vehicle manufacturing and supply chain at COP31 in Antalya. Executives highlighted the necessity of action across the entire automotive value chain, from raw material sourcing to the final use of vehicles by consumers.

stories.title: KPI Green Energy adds 65.1 MWp to hybrid project
stories.summary: KPI Green Energy commissioned 65.1 MWp of capacity at its hybrid project in Gujarat, bringing its total energized capacity to 575.8 MWp. The project includes a mix of solar and wind energy. The company continues to work toward its planned 677 MWp total capacity target.

stories.title: Waaree Renewable Technologies wins 120 MWp turnkey contract
stories.summary: Waaree Renewable Technologies received a Letter of Award for a 120 MWp turnkey project involving module supply and engineering, procurement, and construction works. The contract was awarded by a private domestic company. The company disclosed the deal following regulatory requirements under SEBI listing obligations.

stories.title: EY report finds widespread corporate decarbonization activity
stories.summary: The latest Climate Action Barometer from EY indicates that businesses remain committed to decarbonization efforts. While the report finds that such activity is widespread, it notes that only a small group of corporate leaders currently have comprehensive transition plans in place to cut emissions and enhance resilience.
